title: 請假與排班
description: 請假、排班與休假相關用語

sentences.en: I'd like to take a day off tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我想明天請一天假。

sentences.en: I need to call in sick today.
sentences.zh: 我今天需要請病假。

sentences.en: Could you cover for me on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你可以星期五幫我代班嗎？

sentences.en: I'm planning to use my vacation days next month.
sentences.zh: 我打算下個月使用我的休假天數。

sentences.en: What's the procedure for requesting time off?
sentences.zh: 請假的流程是什麼？

sentences.en: I submitted my leave request yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天提交了請假申請。

sentences.en: My shift starts at 9 a.m. and ends at 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我的班次從早上九點到下午六點。

sentences.en: Can we swap shifts next week?
sentences.zh: 我們下週可以換班嗎？

sentences.en: I have three days of annual leave remaining.
sentences.zh: 我還剩三天年假。

sentences.en: The schedule for next month has been posted.
sentences.zh: 下個月的排班表已經公布了。

sentences.en: I need to leave early for a doctor's appointment.
sentences.zh: 我需要提早離開去看醫生。

sentences.en: Is it possible to work from home tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天可以在家工作嗎？

sentences.en: I'll be on maternity leave starting next month.
sentences.zh: 我下個月開始休產假。

sentences.en: Who's covering the night shift tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚誰值夜班？

sentences.en: I'd like to request a half-day off this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我想申請今天下午請半天假。

sentences.en: My leave has been approved by my manager.
sentences.zh: 我的請假已經被主管批准了。

sentences.en: We're short-staffed this week, so no one can take leave.
sentences.zh: 這週人手不足，所以沒人可以請假。

sentences.en: I'll make up the hours next week.
sentences.zh: 我下週會把時數補回來。

sentences.en: Could you check if I have any overtime hours to use?
sentences.zh: 你能查一下我是否有加班時數可以用嗎？

sentences.en: The rotating schedule changes every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 輪班表每兩週更換一次。

sentences.en: I'm taking personal leave to handle some family matters.
sentences.zh: 我要請事假處理一些家庭事務。

sentences.en: Please let me know if there are any schedule conflicts.
sentences.zh: 如果有排班衝突，請告訴我。

sentences.en: I won't be available during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 假期期間我無法上班。

sentences.en: Do we get compensatory time off for working weekends?
sentences.zh: 週末加班有補休嗎？

sentences.en: I need to take bereavement leave this week.
sentences.zh: 我這週需要請喪假。

sentences.en: The deadline for submitting leave requests is this Friday.
sentences.zh: 提交請假申請的截止日期是這週五。

sentences.en: I'll be back in the office on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我星期一會回到辦公室。

sentences.en: Can I take an unpaid leave of absence?
sentences.zh: 我可以請留職停薪嗎？

sentences.en: Please find someone to fill in for me while I'm away.
sentences.zh: 我不在的時候請找人代替我。

sentences.en: I've already arranged for someone to handle my tasks during my leave.
sentences.zh: 我已經安排人在我請假期間處理我的工作了。
